case_name: Vikash Chandra vs State Of Bihar & Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Vikash Chandra, son of Sita Sharan Prasad, resident of Asha Sadan, Yamuna Path, Back of Punjab National Bank, New Bye Pass Road, Anisabad, P.S. - Beur, District - Patna
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Bihar and Aparna Sinha, wife of Vikash Chandra, daughter of Kesho Prasad, resident of Adarsh Colony, West Patel Nagar, P.S.- Shastri Nagar, District- Patna

facts_of_case: Vikash Chandra seeks quashing of the order dated 7.6.2014 passed by the Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Patna, Distt. Patna, in Shastri Nagar P.S. Case No. 29 of 2013.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to quash a criminal proceeding to demonstrate that the continuation of the same would cause irreparable harm.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the court will not interfere with the process of law unless there are compelling reasons for doing so. The petitioners have failed to demonstrate any such compelling reason.
use_in: case type: quashing of criminal proceedings

legal_principles.principle: A dispute resolved through payment can be considered as finally resolved.
legal_principles.held: The dispute has now been finally resolved on payment of Rs.4,00,000/- by Demand Drafts No. 013835, 013714, 013836.

outcome.final_order: The dispute has now been finally resolved on payment of Rs.4,00,000/- by Demand Drafts.
